GatewayOAuthLoginParams.description: Authorize a configured service without changing the selected model provider.

deviceAuth.description: Select device authorization when the server advertises support for it.

modelProvider.description: Defaults to the current provider when omitted.

target.description: Available only on `--startup-oauth`. Mutually exclusive with `modelProvider`.

GatewayOAuthTarget.description: An explicit service to authorize instead of the selected model provider.
